subject: Data-address-identifier
notes: kb/Work PB1062. First sentence: FILE, WORKING-STORAGE, LOCAL-STORAGE and LINKAGE items are admitted (landed PB1019); a SCREEN SECTION or REPORT SECTION entry, a constant-name and a special register identify no data item and are refused COBOL0869 whose message now names this rule (ISO 8.4.3.11.3 SR1) instead of 'unresolvable, reference-modified'. Second sentence: an item of an OBJECT's or FACTORY's WORKING-STORAGE or FILE section (any root of a class unit that is not method-scoped, DataBinder.OoIsObjectData) is refused COBOL2784 by AddressOfOperandScreen in every surface (SET sender, relation operand, CALL argument), pinned by negative pb1062-address-of-object-data (object and factory halves; the method's own LOCAL-STORAGE is legal in the same statements).
